text: You turn 40. A card says you're "not old, just vintage". You keep it, and hate it.
There's a red convertible in the showroom window. It knows your name.

right.label: Buy it
right.result: It rains for the next five months.

text: The menu has got smaller. All menus have got smaller.
Your knee now predicts the weather, with more accuracy than the forecast.
A letter invites you for a routine screening. It uses the word "just" four times.

risk.result: They find it later than they should have. The treatment is hard.

right.label: Go
right.result: All clear. You treat yourself to a sandwich.

text: The nurse pumps the cuff twice, frowns, and asks about your week.

right.label: Cut the salt and walk more

text: There's a tight feeling in your chest on the stairs. It's probably nothing.

death.cause: a heart attack on the stairs

risk.result: You wake up in a hospital with a stent.

right.label: Go to the ER
right.result: They catch it in time. A doctor uses the phrase "wake-up call".

text: A parent has started repeating the same story. You've heard it three times this visit.
A parent can't manage alone any more, and the care home brochure has a lot of smiling in it.
The funeral's on Friday. Somebody needs to say a few words, and everybody looks at you.

right.label: Say them
right.result: You get through it. Then you find their handwriting on a shopping list.

text: A friend from your twenties died. You find out from a post, between two adverts.

right.label: Call the old group
right.result: You promise to meet more than at funerals.

text: The promotion went to someone who was born the year you started working.
An email invites you to a meeting about "exciting changes". It's from HR, with a box of tissues.

risk.result: You keep the job. You lose your desk, your team and your window.

text: Work has a new system. The twenty-three-year-old explaining it is being very gentle with you.
Your pension statement has arrived. There's a graph, and it's not a nice shape.
A man on the radio says it isn't too late to get rich. His seminar is $2,000.

risk.result: The main lesson is to run seminars.

text: A doctor says you need more exercise. The local swimming pool has a slow lane.

right.label: Join the slow lane
right.result: Everyone in it has opinions about the fast lane.

text: You've got time on your weekends again. There's a choir, or a shed.

right.label: The choir
right.result: You're told to mime the high bits.

text: Your school bully friends you online. They've found peace, and they'd like to talk about it.

right.label: Hear them out
right.result: They don't remember the thing you've remembered for thirty years.

text: A local college wants people to mentor students in your line of work.
You've gone up a size. The shop assistant calls it "relaxed fit".
Your hairline has moved out without telling you.

risk.result: It comes back in a straight line. People look at it.

text: A clinic promises to take ten years off your face. Your face would have to stay very still.

risk.result: You look permanently surprised, which is at least honest.

text: You could retrain and do what you wanted to do at twenty. Everyone says you're mad.
A distant aunt has left you some money, and also a large collection of spoons.
You're invited to a party that starts at nine. At night.

right.label: Go
right.result: You leave at ten and feel wonderful about it.

text: The doctor asks how much you drink. You halve it. The doctor doubles it.
You're awake at 4am again, thinking about something you said in 1998.
Someone young is crying at the bus stop, and pretending not to.

right.label: Ask if they're all right
right.result: They're fine. They tell you anyway, and the bus comes twice.

text: You've started counting the years to retirement. You have an app for it.

right.label: Check it at lunch
right.result: It has a little countdown, and a confetti setting.
